validity.recommendation: Do NOT recommend deleting or merging P2372 into P0756 -- new evidence this cycle (Gazprom's own engineering encyclopedia explicitly naming 'Починки — Ярославль' as an EXISTING, distinct trunk pipeline predating and separate from Pochinki-Gryazovets; eprussia.ru independently naming it as a second distinct trunk that a 2021 Kostroma GRES branch connects to) shows this is very likely a genuine, real, physically distinct pipeline, not a fabricated duplicate. HOWEVER: flag for a future researcher that P2372's Diameter=1420mm and Capacity=36.00 bcm/y values are suspicious -- they are IDENTICAL to figures independently sourced for sibling row P0756 (Pochinki-Gryazovets), and no source specific to Pochinki-Yaroslavl stating either figure was found. Combined with GEM's own ResearcherNotes admission that P2372's route MAP was originally a literal copy of P0756's map (later partially corrected), this pattern (map copied + Diameter/Capacity appearing to be copied from the same sibling row's DESIGN-spec figures) suggests these two spec fields may have been erroneously carried over from P0756 rather than independently researched for Pochinki-Yaroslavl. Recommend a future pass specifically target Gazprom Transgaz Yaroslavl or Vologda subsidiary sources, or the smu-vyborg.ru engineering-firm project listing (unreachable in this research -- HTTP timeout on every attempt), for independently-sourced Pochinki-Yaroslavl-specific spec values.

validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: substantially resolved IN FAVOR of a real, distinct pipeline this cycle (reversing the prior working hypothesis that this might be a pure GEM digitizing error). Gazprom's own engineering encyclopedia (proektirovanie.gazprom.ru, the SAME page GEM's own wiki_citations cite for P0756) states the Pochinki-Gryazovets project (built 2006-2009) was constructed 'в коридоре существующих газопроводов Починки — Ярославль и Грязовец — КГМО' (in the corridor of the EXISTING pipelines Pochinki-Yaroslavl and Gryazovets-KGMO) -- i.e. Gazprom's own literature treats Pochinki-Yaroslavl as an older, pre-existing, physically distinct trunk pipeline, not a name invented for this GEM row. eprussia.ru (2021, independent trade press) separately confirms a new Kostroma GRES branch (газопровод-отвод, 56.3km) connects to TWO named existing trunk lines, 'Починки — Ярославль' and 'Починки — Грязовец', treating them explicitly as two separate objects. energybase.ru has its own dedicated page for 'pochinki-yaroslavl' (distinct URL slug from its Pochinki-Gryazovets page), though that page carries no independent spec data of its own beyond the Kostroma GRES story. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a transmission trunk (both sources explicitly call it магистральный). DUPLICATE: NOT a straightforward duplicate of P0756 -- it is a real, separate, historically older pipeline in a similar corridor -- but the ROUTE GEOMETRY risk GEM's own notes admit (map literally copied from P0756, only partially corrected) is a live ATTRIBUTION/ROUTE concern regardless of the existence question. One residual ambiguity, NOT force-resolved: a construction-industry page (smu-vyborg.ru, unreachable in this research -- persistent HTTP timeout on every retry attempt across this session) reportedly labels a project as 'Pochinki-Gryazovets pipeline, section Pochinki-Yaroslavl, km 101.6-170.1', which would frame 'Pochinki-Yaroslavl' as an internal SECTION NAME of the Pochinki-Gryazovets project rather than a fully separate trunk -- this cannot be verified or cited (source unreachable) and is recorded here as an uncited lead only, not used to override the two verified sources above. ATTRIBUTION: Owner correctly Gazprom PJSC. SPEC: Fuel/PipelineType/Location/Status all well-corroborated (2 independent sources each); Diameter and Capacity are the live concern (see contested), left UNRESOLVED as fills rather than reusing what may be P0756's misattributed figures. Net verdict: concern (attribution/spec), not clean, and NOT an existence/duplicate finding -- this is very likely a real pipeline with two specific numeric fields of doubtful independent sourcing.
